sentences.en: At the busy airport terminal, an airplane waits outside the window.
sentences.zh: 在繁忙的機場航廈，一架飛機停在窗外等候。

sentences.en: A baggage cart carries suitcases outside.
sentences.zh: 外面有一台行李拖車載運著行李箱。

sentences.en: A passenger carries a heavy bag and waits in line near the gate.
sentences.zh: 一位乘客提著沉重的旅行袋，在登機門附近排隊等候。

sentences.en: There is an empty seat beside the line.
sentences.zh: 隊伍旁邊有一個空座位。

sentences.en: A clock hangs above a screen.
sentences.zh: 螢幕上方掛著一個時鐘。

sentences.en: A woman in a uniform checks each ticket.
sentences.zh: 一位穿制服的女士核對每張票券。

sentences.en: A boy shows his ticket to her.
sentences.zh: 一個男孩向她出示票券。

sentences.en: His family is ready to board the airplane through the passage inside the airbridge.
sentences.zh: 他的家人已準備好經由空橋內的通道登機。

scenes.textEn: At the busy airport terminal, an airplane waits outside the window. A baggage cart carries suitcases outside. A passenger carries a heavy bag and waits in line near the gate. There is an empty seat beside the line. A clock hangs above a screen. A woman in a uniform checks each ticket. A boy shows his ticket to her. His family is ready to board the airplane through the passage inside the airbridge.
scenes.textZh: 在繁忙的機場航廈，一架飛機停在窗外等候。外面有一台行李拖車載運著行李箱。一位乘客提著沉重的旅行袋，在登機門附近排隊等候。隊伍旁邊有一個空座位。螢幕上方掛著一個時鐘。一位穿制服的女士核對每張票券。一個男孩向她出示票券。他的家人已準備好經由空橋內的通道登機。

scenes.titleZh: 飯店櫃檯入住與周邊服務

targets.senseZh: 留下（在此以leave luggage表達寄放行李）

sentences.en: At the hotel front desk, guests check in with a friendly receptionist.
sentences.zh: 在飯店櫃檯，住客向友善的接待員辦理入住。

sentences.en: One guest has a reservation and shows her passport.
sentences.zh: 其中一位住客有訂房，並出示她的護照。

sentences.en: Another guest uses a pen to sign a form while the receptionist gives the woman a key card.
sentences.zh: 另一位住客用筆在表格上簽名，同時接待員把房卡交給那位女士。

sentences.en: A bell sits on the desk.
sentences.zh: 櫃檯上放著一個服務鈴。

sentences.en: Another guest asks, “Can I leave my luggage here?”
sentences.zh: 另一位住客問：「我可以把行李寄放在這裡嗎？」

sentences.en: A porter puts a tag on a suitcase and sets it on a cart.
sentences.zh: 一位行李員在行李箱上掛上吊牌，並把它放到推車上。

sentences.en: Beside the desk, travelers can have water, hot tea, or coffee in a cup.
sentences.zh: 在櫃檯旁邊，旅客可以用杯子取用水、熱茶或咖啡。

sentences.en: A nearby shelf holds a towel, soap, shampoo, a toothbrush, and toothpaste.
sentences.zh: 附近的架上放著毛巾、肥皂、洗髮精、牙刷與牙膏。

sentences.en: A guest asks for a toothbrush, and another receptionist gives one to him.
sentences.zh: 一位住客索取牙刷，另一位接待員拿了一支給他。

scenes.textEn: At the hotel front desk, guests check in with a friendly receptionist. One guest has a reservation and shows her passport. Another guest uses a pen to sign a form while the receptionist gives the woman a key card. A bell sits on the desk. Another guest asks, “Can I leave my luggage here?” A porter puts a tag on a suitcase and sets it on a cart. Beside the desk, travelers can have water, hot tea, or coffee in a cup. A nearby shelf holds a towel, soap, shampoo, a toothbrush, and toothpaste. A guest asks for a toothbrush, and another receptionist gives one to him.
scenes.textZh: 在飯店櫃檯，住客向友善的接待員辦理入住。其中一位住客有訂房，並出示她的護照。另一位住客用筆在表格上簽名，同時接待員把房卡交給那位女士。櫃檯上放著一個服務鈴。另一位住客問：「我可以把行李寄放在這裡嗎？」一位行李員在行李箱上掛上吊牌，並把它放到推車上。在櫃檯旁邊，旅客可以用杯子取用水、熱茶或咖啡。附近的架上放著毛巾、肥皂、洗髮精、牙刷與牙膏。一位住客索取牙刷，另一位接待員拿了一支給他。

sentences.en: On a sunny day, a large ship sails across the sea toward an island.
sentences.zh: 在晴朗的一天，一艘大船航行在海上，朝一座島嶼前進。

sentences.en: A small boat passes near the ship.
sentences.zh: 一艘小船從大船附近經過。

sentences.en: The captain is at the front, and a sailor works with a rope below a flag.
sentences.zh: 船長在船的前方，一位船員在旗幟下方整理繩索。

sentences.en: A passenger sits on a bench with a bag beside him.
sentences.zh: 一位乘客坐在長椅上，身旁放著旅行袋。

sentences.en: It is windy, so he holds his hat.
sentences.zh: 風很大，所以他按住自己的帽子。

sentences.en: A child watches a wave beside the ship.
sentences.zh: 一個孩子看著船邊的一道波浪。

scenes.textEn: On a sunny day, a large ship sails across the sea toward an island. A small boat passes near the ship. The captain is at the front, and a sailor works with a rope below a flag. A passenger sits on a bench with a bag beside him. It is windy, so he holds his hat. A child watches a wave beside the ship.
scenes.textZh: 在晴朗的一天，一艘大船航行在海上，朝一座島嶼前進。一艘小船從大船附近經過。船長在船的前方，一位船員在旗幟下方整理繩索。一位乘客坐在長椅上，身旁放著旅行袋。風很大，所以他按住自己的帽子。一個孩子看著船邊的一道波浪。

scenes.titleZh: 飛機上的餐飲與艙等體驗

sentences.en: Inside the cabin, a passenger opens an overhead bin with luggage inside.
sentences.zh: 在機艙內，一位乘客打開上方放著行李的行李艙。

sentences.en: In business class, the seats are wide and comfortable.
sentences.zh: 商務艙的座位寬敞又舒適。

sentences.en: A traveler eats a meal from a plate, while another seat holds a pillow and a blanket.
sentences.zh: 一位旅客吃著盤中的餐點，另一張座位上放著枕頭與毯子。

sentences.en: Behind a curtain, economy class has narrow seats arranged in rows.
sentences.zh: 隔簾後方的經濟艙，較窄的座椅一排排排列。

sentences.en: One flight attendant serves a tray to a passenger beside a cart.
sentences.zh: 一位空服員在餐車旁，將托盤遞給乘客。

sentences.en: The cart holds water, juice, and more meals.
sentences.zh: 餐車上放著水、果汁與更多餐點。

sentences.en: Another flight attendant pours juice into a cup.
sentences.zh: 另一位空服員把果汁倒進杯子。

sentences.en: A passenger wears headphones and drinks from his cup.
sentences.zh: 一位乘客戴著耳機，用杯子喝飲料。

sentences.en: A magazine sits in a pocket below a screen.
sentences.zh: 螢幕下方的口袋裡放著一本雜誌。

sentences.en: Clouds fill the view through each window, and the wing and engine are outside the cabin.
sentences.zh: 透過窗戶可以看見雲，機翼與引擎則位於機艙外。

scenes.textEn: Inside the cabin, a passenger opens an overhead bin with luggage inside. In business class, the seats are wide and comfortable. A traveler eats a meal from a plate, while another seat holds a pillow and a blanket. Behind a curtain, economy class has narrow seats arranged in rows. One flight attendant serves a tray to a passenger beside a cart. The cart holds water, juice, and more meals. Another flight attendant pours juice into a cup. A passenger wears headphones and drinks from his cup. A magazine sits in a pocket below a screen. Clouds fill the view through each window, and the wing and engine are outside the cabin.
scenes.textZh: 在機艙內，一位乘客打開上方放著行李的行李艙。商務艙的座位寬敞又舒適。一位旅客吃著盤中的餐點，另一張座位上放著枕頭與毯子。隔簾後方的經濟艙，較窄的座椅一排排排列。一位空服員在餐車旁，將托盤遞給乘客。餐車上放著水、果汁與更多餐點。另一位空服員把果汁倒進杯子。一位乘客戴著耳機，用杯子喝飲料。螢幕下方的口袋裡放著一本雜誌。透過窗戶可以看見雲，機翼與引擎則位於機艙外。
